**Motif:** attraction (the check draws the king to h8, where the bishop becomes undefended)

**Coaching note:**

When your opponent's king is on g8 with f7 and g7 as the only escape squares, look for back-rank patterns. Here, Qxf7+ forces Kh8 (the only legal move), then Qxg7 is mate because the king has nowhere to go and the bishop falls with check. Always calculate forcing checks first—they often lead to mating attacks.
